Model Text Summary:
A folklore-inspired narrative about Gopi, a compassionate young artist gifted with a magical paintbrush that brings his drawings to life. Gopi uses his art selflessly, painting plows, food, and livestock for struggling villagers. When a greedy local Zamindar captures Gopi and demands a golden palace and endless treasure, Gopi refuses to misuse art for tyranny. Instead, Gopi paints an ocean and a raging storm that swallows the Zamindar's ship, liberating the village from oppression.
